native_mechanism_note: LOSSY: recipe inserts 0.3s pure-black via concat (hard comma); fadeblack dissolves through black (gradual != hard insert).
description: Brief full-black insert between clips. Acts as a breath — narrative comma. Lets the prior beat land before the next begins. Audio can continue (bed) or fully dip.
ffmpeg_recipe: ffmpeg -y -i {clip_a} -i {clip_b} -f lavfi -t 0.3 -i "color=c=black:s=1080x1920:r=30" -f lavfi -t 0.3 -i "anullsrc=channel_layout=stereo:sample_rate=44100" -filter_complex "[0:v][2:v][1:v]concat=n=3:v=1:a=0[v];[0:a][3:a][1:a]concat=n=3:v=0:a=1[a]" -map "[v]" -map "[a]" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -c:a aac -b:a 192k {output}
audio_recipe: Option A (full silence — narrative weight): anullsrc 0.3s replaces audio entirely. Option B (bed continues): omit anullsrc segment, concat only video; clip_a audio tail + clip_b audio head play across the black with natural fade.
use_cases: After a reveal — let viewer process before next beat
Between H4 (escalation) and H5 (climax) for breath
Replacing a cut where pacing demands a comma
avoid_for: Hot pacing windows (first 30s of reel — kills retention)
More than 1-2 per reel — overuse turns into dead air
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP: 0.3s gap between clipA end and clipB start, with a full-screen black div z-index 99 opacity 1.0. Audio bed continues underneath via assets/library/ambient track.
canonical_observations: Observed in ref-03 (fade negro rápido at 28.5-29.0s + 49.2-49.7s + 71.7-72.0s — quick black inserts hiding death cuts, descriptive § 6 'fade a negro muy rápido o impacto visual oculta el corte') and ref-08 ('Hard cut a fade negro post-muerte' descriptive § 6 + Beat 8 'Pablo apaga luces / visual fade to dark'). ref-12 has fade out at 111-113s but that is outro-length not 0.3s breath. ref-06/09/10/11/13 show no explicit black-screen breath inserts in narrative descriptions. Pattern: F1 uses 0.3s black mainly to mask death-cut frames, not as inter-beat narrative comma.
validated_notes: Explicit in 2/8 F1 referents as death-cut mask (0.3-0.5s). Hard rule: in short-form, max 2x per reel. Use case 'narrative breath between beats' is INFERRED not directly observed in F1 refs (prior 'ref-02/ref-06' citation was incorrect — corrected 2026-05-22).
